def rotr (n : Nat) (x : Word) : Word := x.rotateRight n

def ch (x y z : Word) : Word := (x &&& y) ^^^ (~x &&& z)
def maj (x y z : Word) : Word := (x &&& y) ^^^ (x &&& z) ^^^ (y &&& z)
def sigma0 (x : Word) : Word := rotr 2 x ^^^ rotr 13 x ^^^ rotr 22 x
def sigma1 (x : Word) : Word := rotr 6 x ^^^ rotr 11 x ^^^ rotr 25 x
def gamma0 (x : Word) : Word := rotr 7 x ^^^ rotr 18 x ^^^ (x >>> 3)
def gamma1 (x : Word) : Word := rotr 17 x ^^^ rotr 19 x ^^^ (x >>> 10)

def init : State := #[0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19]

def processBlock (st : State) (chunk : Array Word) : State :=
  let mut w := chunk ++ Array.mkArray 48 0
  for i in [16:64] do
    let s0 := gamma0 w[i-15]!
    let s1 := gamma1 w[i-2]!
    w := w.set! i ((w[i-16]! + s0 + w[i-7]! + s1) % UInt32.modulus)
  
  let mut a := st[0]!; let mut b := st[1]!; let mut c := st[2]!; let mut d := st[3]!
  let mut e := st[4]!; let mut f := st[5]!; let mut g := st[6]!; let mut h := st[7]!
  
  for i in [:64] do
    let S1 := sigma1 e
    let ch' := ch e f g
    let temp1 := h + S1 + ch' + k[i]! + w[i]!
    let S0 := sigma0 a
    let maj' := maj a b c
    let temp2 := S0 + maj'
    h := g; g := f; f := e; e := d + temp1
    d := c; c := b; b := a; a := temp1 + temp2

  #[a + st[0]!, b + st[1]!, c + st[2]!, d + st[3]!, e + st[4]!, f + st[5]!, g + st[6]!, h + st[7]!]

partial def update (st : State) (msg : ByteArray) : State := Id.run do
  let mut s := st
  let mut buf : Array Word := {}
  let mut bufByteIdx : Nat := 0
  let mut tmpWord : UInt32 := 0
  
  for byte in msg do
    tmpWord := tmpWord <<< 8 ||| byte.toUInt32
    bufByteIdx := bufByteIdx + 1
    if bufByteIdx == 4 then
      buf := buf.push tmpWord
      bufByteIdx := 0
      tmpWord := 0
      if buf.size == 16 then
        s := processBlock s buf
        buf := []

  let totalLen := msg.size.toUInt64 * 8
  let padBit : UInt8 := 0x80
  tmpWord := tmpWord <<< 8 ||| padBit.toUInt32
  bufByteIdx := bufByteIdx + 1
  if bufByteIdx == 4 then
    buf := buf.push tmpWord
    bufByteIdx := 0
    tmpWord := 0
  
  if buf.size > 14 || (buf.size == 14 && bufByteIdx > 0) then
    while buf.size < 16 do
      let w := if bufByteIdx == 0 then 0 else (tmpWord <<< (8 * (4 - bufByteIdx)))
      buf := buf.push w
      bufByteIdx := 0
      tmpWord := 0
    s := processBlock s buf
    buf := []

  while buf.size < 14 do
    let w := if bufByteIdx == 0 then 0 else (tmpWord <<< (8 * (4 - bufByteIdx)))
    buf := buf.push w
    bufByteIdx := 0
    tmpWord := 0
  
  let hi := (totalLen >>> 32).toUInt32
  let lo := totalLen.toUInt32
  buf := buf.push hi
  buf := buf.push lo
  while buf.size < 16 do
    buf := buf.push 0
  
  processBlock s buf

def final (st : State) : ByteArray :=
  let out := ByteArray.empty
  st.foldl (fun acc w => 
    acc ++ w.toBEBytes
  ) out

def hash (msg : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  final (update init msg)
end Sha256

abbrev ComplexFloat := Complex Float

structure Qubit where
  a : ComplexFloat
  b : ComplexFloat

namespace Qubit
def init (a b : ComplexFloat) : Qubit :=
  let ns := a.re * a.re + a.im * a.im + b.re * b.re + b.im * b.im
  if ns == 0 || ns.isNaN || ns.isInfinite then
    { a := 1.0, b := 0.0 }
  else
    let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt ns
    let s := { re := inv, im := 0.0 }
    { a := a * s, b := b * s }

def initBasis0 : Qubit := { a := 1.0, b := 0.0 }
def initBasis1 : Qubit := { a := 0.0, b := 1.0 }

def normSquared (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  q.a.re * q.a.re + q.a.im * q.a.im + q.b.re * q.b.re + q.b.im * q.b.im

def prob0 (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  let p := q.a.re * q.a.re + q.a.im * q.a.im
  if p < 0.0 then 0.0 else if p > 1.0 then 1.0 else p

def prob1 (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  let p := q.b.re * q.b.re + q.b.im * q.b.im
  if p < 0.0 then 0.0 else if p > 1.0 then 1.0 else p
end Qubit

namespace QuantumMath
open Complex Real

def QubitMath := Complex ℝ × Complex ℝ

def normSq (q : QubitMath) : ℝ := (q.1 * conj q.1).re + (q.2 * conj q.2).re

def isUnit (q : QubitMath) : Prop := normSq q = 1

def hadamardMath (q : QubitMath) : QubitMath :=
  let s := (1 / √ 2)
  ((s * (q.1 + q.2), s * (q.1 - q.2)))

def pauliXMath (q : QubitMath) : QubitMath := (q.2, q.1)

def pauliYMath (q : QubitMath) : QubitMath := ((-I) * q.2, I * q.1)

def pauliZMath (q : QubitMath) : QubitMath := (q.1, -q.2)

def phaseMath (θ : ℝ) (q : QubitMath) : QubitMath := (q.1, Complex.exp (θ * I) * q.2)

theorem hadamard_preserves_norm (q : QubitMath) (h : isUnit q) : isUnit (hadamardMath q) := by
  calc
    normSq (hadamardMath q)
    = ((1/2) * (q.1 + q.2) * conj (q.1 + q.2)).re + ((1/2) * (q.1 - q.2) * conj (q.1 - q.2)).re := by
        unfold normSq hadamardMath; field_simp [Complex.mul_add, Complex.add_mul, Complex.sub_mul, Complex.mul_sub]
    _ = (1/2) * ((q.1 * conj q.1).re + (q.2 * conj q.2).re + (q.1 * conj q.2).re + (q.2 * conj q.1).re)
      + (1/2) * ((q.1 * conj q.1).re + (q.2 * conj q.2).re - (q.1 * conj q.2).re - (q.2 * conj q.1).re) := by
        have h1 : (q.1 + q.2) * conj (q.1 + q.2) = q.1 * conj q.1 + q.2 * conj q.2 + q.1 * conj q.2 + q.2 * conj q.1 := by ring
        have h2 : (q.1 - q.2) * conj (q.1 - q.2) = q.1 * conj q.1 + q.2 * conj q.2 - q.1 * conj q.2 - q.2 * conj q.1 := by ring
        rw [h1, h2]
        simp only [Complex.re_add, Complex.re_mul]
        ring
    _ = (1/2) * (normSq q + normSq q) := by
        unfold normSq
        ring
    _ = normSq q := by ring
    _ = 1 := h

theorem pauliX_preserves_norm (q : QubitMath) (h : isUnit q) : isUnit (pauliXMath q) := by
  unfold isUnit normSq pauliXMath; exact h

theorem pauliY_preserves_norm (q : QubitMath) (h : isUnit q) : isUnit (pauliYMath q) := by
  unfold isUnit normSq pauliYMath
  have : I * conj I = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.conj_I]; simp [Complex.mul]
  simp only [Complex.mul_assoc, this, Complex.one_mul, Complex.mul_neg]
  have : (-I) * conj (-I) = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.conj_neg, Complex.conj_I]; simp [Complex.mul]
  simp only [this, Complex.mul_assoc, Complex.one_mul]
  unfold normSq; ring

theorem pauliZ_preserves_norm (q : QubitMath) (h : isUnit q) : isUnit (pauliZMath q) := by
  unfold isUnit normSq pauliZMath
  have : (-1 : ℝ) * (-1) = 1 := by ring
  have : (-q.2) * conj (-q.2) = q.2 * conj q.2 := by
    simp [Complex.mul, Complex.conj, this]
  simp only [this]
  ring

theorem phase_preserves_norm (θ : ℝ) (q : QubitMath) (h : isUnit q) : isUnit (phaseMath θ q) := by
  unfold isUnit normSq phaseMath
  have : Complex.abs (Complex.exp (θ * I)) = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.abs_exp]; simp
  have : (Complex.exp (θ * I) * q.2) * conj (Complex.exp (θ * I) * q.2) = q.2 * conj q.2 := by
    rw [Complex.mul_conj]; rw [this]; simp
  simp only [this]
  ring

theorem prob_sum_one (q : QubitMath) (h : isUnit q) :
  (q.1 * conj q.1).re + (q.2 * conj q.2).re = 1 := by
  exact h
end QuantumMath

structure TwoQubit where
  amps : Array ComplexFloat

namespace TwoQubit
def initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt 2.0
  { amps := #[{ re := inv, im := 0.0 }, 0.0, 0.0, { re := inv, im := 0.0 }] }
end TwoQubit

abbrev Gate := Qubit → Qubit

def hadamardGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt 2.0
  let s := { re := inv, im := 0.0 }
  let a := (q.a + q.b) * s
  let b := (q.a - q.b) * s
  Qubit.init a b

def pauliXGate : Gate := fun q => Qubit.init q.b q.a

def pauliYGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let i := { re := 0.0, im := 1.0 }
  let mi := { re := 0.0, im := -1.0 }
  Qubit.init (mi * q.b) (i * q.a)

def pauliZGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let m1 := { re := -1.0, im := 0.0 }
  Qubit.init q.a (q.b * m1)

def identityGate : Gate := fun q => q

def phaseGate (phase : Float) : Gate :=
  let c := Float.cos phase
  let s := Float.sin phase
  let e := { re := c, im := s }
  fun q => Qubit.init q.a (q.b * e)

structure EdgeKey where
  source : String
  target : String

instance : BEq EdgeKey where
  beq a b := a.source == b.source && a.target == b.target

instance : Hashable EdgeKey where
  hash k := mixHash 0 (hash k.source) (hash k.target)

structure PairKey where
  a : String
  b : String

instance : BEq PairKey where
  beq x y := x.a == y.a && x.b == y.b

instance : Hashable PairKey where
  hash k := mixHash 1 (hash k.a) (hash k.b)

structure SelfSimilarRelationalGraph where
  nodes : HashMap String Node
  edges : HashMap EdgeKey (Array Edge)
  entanglements : HashMap PairKey TwoQubit
  quantum_register : HashMap String Qubit
  topology_hash : String := "0".repeat 65
  rng : Std.Random

namespace SelfSimilarRelationalGraph
def init (seed : UInt64) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  {
    nodes := {},
    edges := {},
    entanglements := {},
    quantum_register := {},
    rng := Std.Random.mk seed,
    topology_hash := "0".repeat 65
  }

partial def updateTopologyHash (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  let mut acc_nodes := Array.mkArray 32 0
  let mut acc_edges := Array.mkArray 32 0
  let mut acc_ent := Array.mkArray 32 0

  let mut node_count : UInt64 := 0
  let mut edgekey_count : UInt64 := 0
  let mut total_edge_count : UInt64 := 0
  let mut ent_count : UInt64 := 0

  for (id, node) in g.nodes do
    node_count := node_count + 1
    let mut meta_acc := Array.mkArray 32 0
    let mut meta_count : UInt64 := 0
    for (k, v) in node.metadata do
      meta_count := meta_count + 1
      let mh := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 k)
      let mh := Sha256.update mh v
      let md := Sha256.final mh
      for i in [:32] do
        meta_acc := meta_acc.set! i (meta_acc[i]! ^ md[i]!)
    
    let h := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 node.id)
    let h := Sha256.update h node.data
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node.phase))
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node.qubit.a.re))
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node.qubit.a.im))
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node.qubit.b.re))
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node.qubit.b.im))
    let h := Sha256.update h meta_acc
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString meta_count))
    let d := Sha256.final h
    for i in [:32] do
      acc_nodes := acc_nodes.set! i (acc_nodes[i]! ^ d[i]!)

  for (k, lst) in g.edges do
    edgekey_count := edgekey_count + 1
    let mut edges_acc := Array.mkArray 32 0
    let mut edges_count : UInt64 := 0
    for edge in lst do
      edges_count := edges_count + 1
      total_edge_count := total_edge_count + 1
      let mut emeta_acc := Array.mkArray 32 0
      let mut emeta_count : UInt64 := 0
      for (ek, ev) in edge.metadata do
        emeta_count := emeta_count + 1
        let mh := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 ek)
        let mh := Sha256.update mh ev
        let md := Sha256.final mh
        for i in [:32] do
          emeta_acc := emeta_acc.set! i (emeta_acc[i]! ^ md[i]!)
      
      let eh := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 toString edge.quality)
      let eh := Sha256.update eh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edge.weight))
      let eh := Sha256.update eh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edge.fractal_dimension))
      let eh := Sha256.update eh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edge.quantum_correlation.re))
      let eh := Sha256.update eh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edge.quantum_correlation.im))
      let eh := Sha256.update eh emeta_acc
      let eh := Sha256.update eh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString emeta_count))
      let ed := Sha256.final eh
      for i in [:32] do
        edges_acc := edges_acc.set! i (edges_acc[i]! ^ ed[i]!)

    let kh := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 k.source)
    let kh := Sha256.update kh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 k.target)
    let kh := Sha256.update kh edges_acc
    let kh := Sha256.update kh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edges_count))
    let kd := Sha256.final kh
    for i in [:32] do
      acc_edges := acc_edges.set! i (acc_edges[i]! ^ kd[i]!)

  for (k, v) in g.entanglements do
    ent_count := ent_count + 1
    let h := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 k.a)
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 k.b)
    for c in v.amps do
      let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString c.re))
      let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString c.im))
    let d := Sha256.final h
    for i in [:32] do
      acc_ent := acc_ent.set! i (acc_ent[i]! ^ d[i]!)

  let final := Sha256.update Sha256.init acc_nodes
  let final := Sha256.update final (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node_count))
  let final := Sha256.update final acc_edges
  let final := Sha256.update final (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edgekey_count))
  let final := Sha256.update final (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString total_edge_count))
  let final := Sha256.update final acc_ent
  let final := Sha256.update final (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString ent_count))
  let digest := Sha256.final final
  let hex := digest.foldl (fun acc b => acc ++ b.toHex) ""
  return { g with topology_hash := hex ++ "0" }

def addNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node : Node) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  let nodes := if g.nodes.contains node.id then
      let existing := g.nodes.find! node.id
      let nodes := g.nodes.erase node.id
      nodes.insert node.id { existing with data := node.data, qubit := node.qubit, phase := node.phase, metadata := node.metadata }
    else
      g.nodes.insert node.id node
  let qr := g.quantum_register.erase node.id |>.insert node.id node.qubit
  let g := { g with nodes := nodes, quantum_register := qr }
  g.updateTopologyHash

def addEdge (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (source target : String) (edge : Edge) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  if !(g.nodes.contains source) || !(g.nodes.contains target) then return g
  let key := { source := source, target := target }
  let edges := match g.edges.find? key with
    | some lst => g.edges.insert key (lst.push edge)
    | none => g.edges.insert key #[edge]
  let g := { g with edges := edges }
  g.updateTopologyHash

def getNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : String) : Option Node :=
  g.nodes.find? id

def getEdges (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (source target : String) : Option (Array Edge) :=
  g.edges.find? { source := source, target := target }

def setQuantumState (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) (q : Qubit) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  if !(g.nodes.contains node_id) then return g
  let node := g.nodes.find! node_id
  let nodes := g.nodes.insert node_id { node with qubit := q }
  let qr := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q
  let g := { g with nodes := nodes, quantum_register := qr }
  g.updateTopologyHash

def applyQuantumGate (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) (gate : Gate) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  if !(g.nodes.contains node_id) then return g
  let node := g.nodes.find! node_id
  let q := gate node.qubit
  let nodes := g.nodes.insert node_id { node with qubit := q }
  let qr := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q
  let g := { g with nodes := nodes, quantum_register := qr }
  g.updateTopologyHash

def entangleNodes (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a_id b_id : String) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  if !(g.nodes.contains a_id) || !(g.nodes.contains b_id) then return g
  let pk := if a_id < b_id then { a := a_id, b := b_id } else { a := b_id, b := a_id }
  let ent := g.entanglements.insert pk TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus
  let e1 := { source := a_id, target := b_id, quality := .entangled, weight := 1.0, quantum_correlation := 1.0, fractal_dimension := 0.0 }
  let e2 := { source := b_id, target := a_id, quality := .entangled, weight := 1.0, quantum_correlation := 1.0, fractal_dimension := 0.0 }
  let g := { g with entanglements := ent }
  let g ← g.addEdge a_id b_id e1
  let g ← g.addEdge b_id a_id e2
  return g

def measure (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : IO (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph × Bool) := do
  if !(g.nodes.contains node_id) then return (g, false)
  let entItems := g.entanglements.toArray
  let mut hitKey : Option PairKey := none
  let mut hitVal : Option TwoQubit := none
  for (pk, tv) in entItems do
    if pk.a == node_id || pk.b == node_id then
      hitKey := pk
      hitVal := tv
      break
  
  match hitKey, hitVal with
  | some pk, some state =>
      let r ← g.rng.nextFloat
      let mut cum := 0.0
      let mut outcome := 0
      for amp in state.amps, i in [:4] do
        cum := cum + (amp.re * amp.re + amp.im * amp.im)
        if r <= cum then
          outcome := i
          break
      let a_id := pk.a
      let b_id := pk.b
      let na := match outcome with
        | 0 => Qubit.initBasis0
        | 1 => Qubit.initBasis0
        | 2 => Qubit.initBasis1
        | _ => Qubit.initBasis1
      let nb := match outcome with
        | 0 => Qubit.initBasis0
        | 1 => Qubit.initBasis1
        | 2 => Qubit.initBasis0
        | _ => Qubit.initBasis1
      
      let nodes := g.nodes.insert a_id { (g.nodes.find! a_id) with qubit := na }
      let nodes := nodes.insert b_id { (g.nodes.find! b_id) with qubit := nb }
      let qr := g.quantum_register.insert a_id na |>.insert b_id nb
      let ent := g.entanglements.erase pk
      
      let bit := if node_id == a_id then (outcome >>> 1) &&& 1 else outcome &&& 1

      let edges := match g.edges.find? { source := a_id, target := b_id } with
        | some lst => g.edges.insert { source := a_id, target := b_id } (lst.modify 0 (fun e => { e with quality := .collapsed }))
        | none => g.edges
      let edges := match edges.find? { source := b_id, target := a_id } with
        | some lst => edges.insert { source := b_id, target := a_id } (lst.modify 0 (fun e => { e with quality := .collapsed }))
        | none => edges
      
      let g := { g with nodes := nodes, quantum_register := qr, entanglements := ent, edges := edges }
      let g ← g.updateTopologyHash
      return (g, bit != 0)
  | _, _ =>
      let n := g.nodes.find! node_id
      let p0 := n.qubit.prob0
      let r ← g.rng.nextFloat
      let bit := r <= p0
      let q := if bit then Qubit.initBasis0 else Qubit.initBasis1
      let nodes := g.nodes.insert node_id { n with qubit := q }
      let qr := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q
      let g := { g with nodes := nodes, quantum_register := qr }
      let g ← g.updateTopologyHash
      return (g, !bit)

def nodeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Nat := g.nodes.size
def edgeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Nat := g.edges.foldl (fun acc k lst => acc + lst.size) 0

def encodeInformation (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (data : ByteArray) : IO (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph × String) := do
  let hash := Sha256.hash data
  let id_bytes := hash[0:8]
  let node_id := id_bytes.foldl (fun acc b => acc ++ b.toHex) ""
  
  let node := { id := node_id, data := data, qubit := Qubit.initBasis0, phase := 0.0, metadata := {} }
  let g ← g.addNode node
  
  let ids := g.nodes.keys.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a < b)
  let mut g := g
  if ids.size > 1 then
    let maxLinks := min 3 (ids.size - 1)
    let mut linked := 0
    for i in [:ids.size] do
      if linked >= maxLinks then break
      let prev := ids[ids.size - 1 - i]!
      if prev == node_id then continue
      let e := { source := node_id, target := prev, quality := .coherent, weight := 0.5, quantum_correlation := 0.0, fractal_dimension := 0.0 }
      g ← g.addEdge node_id prev e
      linked := linked + 1
  
  return (g, node_id)

def decodeInformation (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : Option ByteArray :=
  match g.nodes.find? node_id with
  | some n => n.data
  | none => none

theorem node_count_positive (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : 0 ≤ g.nodeCount := by
  apply Nat.zero_le

theorem node_count_add_one (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node : Node) (h : !(g.nodes.contains node.id)) :
  (Id.run do let g' ← g.addNode node; pure g'.nodeCount) = g.nodeCount + 1 := by
  simp [nodeCount, addNode]
  if h_node : g.nodes.contains node.id then
    contradiction
  else
    simp [h_node, HashMap.insert]

theorem edge_count_nonnegative (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : 0 ≤ g.edgeCount := by
  apply Nat.zero_le

theorem entangle_increases_edges (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a_id b_id : String) :
  g.nodes.contains a_id → g.nodes.contains b_id → a_id ≠ b_id →
  (Id.run do let g' ← g.entangleNodes a_id b_id; pure g'.edgeCount) ≥ g.edgeCount + 2 := by
  intro h_a h_b h_neq
  simp [edgeCount, entangleNodes]
  let key_ab := { source := a_id, target := b_id }
  let key_ba := { source := b_id, target := a_id }
  have h_neq_key : key_ab ≠ key_ba := by
    simp [EdgeKey.beq, BEq.beq, not_and_or, h_neq]
    intro h; contradiction
  cases h_eab : g.edges.contains key_ab <;> cases h_eba : g.edges.contains key_ba <;> simp [h_eab, h_eba, h_neq_key]
  repeat (first | apply Nat.le_add_left | apply Nat.le_add_right)

end SelfSimilarRelationalGraph

partial def updateTopologyHash (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  let mut acc_nodes := Array.mkArray 32 0
  let mut acc_edges := Array.mkArray 32 0
  let mut acc_ent := Array.mkArray 32 0

  let mut node_count : UInt64 := 0
  let mut edgekey_count : UInt64 := 0
  let mut total_edge_count : UInt64 := 0
  let mut ent_count : UInt64 := 0

  for (id, node) in g.nodes do
    node_count := node_count + 1
    let mut meta_acc := Array.mkArray 32 0
    let mut meta_count : UInt64 := 0
    for (k, v) in node.metadata do
      meta_count := meta_count + 1
      let mh := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 k)
      let mh := Sha256.update mh v
      let md := Sha256.final mh
      for i in [:32] do
        meta_acc := meta_acc.set! i (meta_acc[i]! ^ md[i]!)
    
    let h := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 node.id)
    let h := Sha256.update h node.data
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node.phase))
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node.qubit.a.re))
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node.qubit.a.im))
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node.qubit.b.re))
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node.qubit.b.im))
    let h := Sha256.update h meta_acc
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString meta_count))
    let d := Sha256.final h
    for i in [:32] do
      acc_nodes := acc_nodes.set! i (acc_nodes[i]! ^ d[i]!)

  for (k, lst) in g.edges do
    edgekey_count := edgekey_count + 1
    let mut edges_acc := Array.mkArray 32 0
    let mut edges_count : UInt64 := 0
    for edge in lst do
      edges_count := edges_count + 1
      total_edge_count := total_edge_count + 1
      let mut emeta_acc := Array.mkArray 32 0
      let mut emeta_count : UInt64 := 0
      for (ek, ev) in edge.metadata do
        emeta_count := emeta_count + 1
        let mh := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 ek)
        let mh := Sha256.update mh ev
        let md := Sha256.final mh
        for i in [:32] do
          emeta_acc := emeta_acc.set! i (emeta_acc[i]! ^ md[i]!)
      
      let eh := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 toString edge.quality)
      let eh := Sha256.update eh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edge.weight))
      let eh := Sha256.update eh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edge.fractal_dimension))
      let eh := Sha256.update eh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edge.quantum_correlation.re))
      let eh := Sha256.update eh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edge.quantum_correlation.im))
      let eh := Sha256.update eh emeta_acc
      let eh := Sha256.update eh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString emeta_count))
      let ed := Sha256.final eh
      for i in [:32] do
        edges_acc := edges_acc.set! i (edges_acc[i]! ^ ed[i]!)

    let kh := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 k.source)
    let kh := Sha256.update kh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 k.target)
    let kh := Sha256.update kh edges_acc
    let kh := Sha256.update kh (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edges_count))
    let kd := Sha256.final kh
    for i in [:32] do
      acc_edges := acc_edges.set! i (acc_edges[i]! ^ kd[i]!)

  for (k, v) in g.entanglements do
    ent_count := ent_count + 1
    let h := Sha256.update Sha256.init (ByteArray.ofUtf8 k.a)
    let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 k.b)
    for c in v.amps do
      let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString c.re))
      let h := Sha256.update h (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString c.im))
    let d := Sha256.final h
    for i in [:32] do
      acc_ent := acc_ent.set! i (acc_ent[i]! ^ d[i]!)

  let final := Sha256.update Sha256.init acc_nodes
  let final := Sha256.update final (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString node_count))
  let final := Sha256.update final acc_edges
  let final := Sha256.update final (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString edgekey_count))
  let final := Sha256.update final (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString total_edge_count))
  let final := Sha256.update final acc_ent
  let final := Sha256.update final (ByteArray.ofUtf8 (toString ent_count))
  let digest := Sha256.final final
  let hex := digest.foldl (fun acc b => acc ++ b.toHex) ""
  return { g with topology_hash := hex ++ "0" }

def addNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node : Node) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  let nodes := if g.nodes.contains node.id then
      let existing := g.nodes.find! node.id
      let nodes := g.nodes.erase node.id
      nodes.insert node.id { existing with data := node.data, qubit := node.qubit, phase := node.phase, metadata := node.metadata }
    else
      g.nodes.insert node.id node
  let qr := g.quantum_register.erase node.id |>.insert node.id node.qubit
  let g := { g with nodes := nodes, quantum_register := qr }
  g.updateTopologyHash

def addEdge (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (source target : String) (edge : Edge) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  if !(g.nodes.contains source) || !(g.nodes.contains target) then return g
  let key := { source := source, target := target }
  let edges := match g.edges.find? key with
    | some lst => g.edges.insert key (lst.push edge)
    | none => g.edges.insert key #[edge]
  let g := { g with edges := edges }
  g.updateTopologyHash

def getNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : String) : Option Node :=
  g.nodes.find? id

def getEdges (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (source target : String) : Option (Array Edge) :=
  g.edges.find? { source := source, target := target }

def setQuantumState (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) (q : Qubit) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  if !(g.nodes.contains node_id) then return g
  let node := g.nodes.find! node_id
  let nodes := g.nodes.insert node_id { node with qubit := q }
  let qr := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q
  let g := { g with nodes := nodes, quantum_register := qr }
  g.updateTopologyHash

def applyQuantumGate (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) (gate : Gate) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  if !(g.nodes.contains node_id) then return g
  let node := g.nodes.find! node_id
  let q := gate node.qubit
  let nodes := g.nodes.insert node_id { node with qubit := q }
  let qr := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q
  let g := { g with nodes := nodes, quantum_register := qr }
  g.updateTopologyHash

def entangleNodes (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a_id b_id : String) : IO SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  if !(g.nodes.contains a_id) || !(g.nodes.contains b_id) then return g
  let pk := if a_id < b_id then { a := a_id, b := b_id } else { a := b_id, b := a_id }
  let ent := g.entanglements.insert pk TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus
  let e1 := { source := a_id, target := b_id, quality := .entangled, weight := 1.0, quantum_correlation := 1.0, fractal_dimension := 0.0 }
  let e2 := { source := b_id, target := a_id, quality := .entangled, weight := 1.0, quantum_correlation := 1.0, fractal_dimension := 0.0 }
  let g := { g with entanglements := ent }
  let g ← g.addEdge a_id b_id e1
  let g ← g.addEdge b_id a_id e2
  return g

def measure (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : IO (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph × Bool) := do
  if !(g.nodes.contains node_id) then return (g, false)
  let entItems := g.entanglements.toArray
  let mut hitKey : Option PairKey := none
  let mut hitVal : Option TwoQubit := none
  for (pk, tv) in entItems do
    if pk.a == node_id || pk.b == node_id then
      hitKey := pk
      hitVal := tv
      break
  
  match hitKey, hitVal with
  | some pk, some state =>
      let r ← g.rng.nextFloat
      let mut cum := 0.0
      let mut outcome := 0
      for amp in state.amps, i in [:4] do
        cum := cum + (amp.re * amp.re + amp.im * amp.im)
        if r <= cum then
          outcome := i
          break
      let a_id := pk.a
      let b_id := pk.b
      let na := match outcome with
        | 0 => Qubit.initBasis0
        | 1 => Qubit.initBasis0
        | 2 => Qubit.initBasis1
        | _ => Qubit.initBasis1
      let nb := match outcome with
        | 0 => Qubit.initBasis0
        | 1 => Qubit.initBasis1
        | 2 => Qubit.initBasis0
        | _ => Qubit.initBasis1
      
      let nodes := g.nodes.insert a_id { (g.nodes.find! a_id) with qubit := na }
      let nodes := nodes.insert b_id { (g.nodes.find! b_id) with qubit := nb }
      let qr := g.quantum_register.insert a_id na |>.insert b_id nb
      let ent := g.entanglements.erase pk
      
      let bit := if node_id == a_id then (outcome >>> 1) &&& 1 else outcome &&& 1

      let edges := match g.edges.find? { source := a_id, target := b_id } with
        | some lst => g.edges.insert { source := a_id, target := b_id } (lst.modify 0 (fun e => { e with quality := .collapsed }))
        | none => g.edges
      let edges := match edges.find? { source := b_id, target := a_id } with
        | some lst => edges.insert { source := b_id, target := a_id } (lst.modify 0 (fun e => { e with quality := .collapsed }))
        | none => edges
      
      let g := { g with nodes := nodes, quantum_register := qr, entanglements := ent, edges := edges }
      let g ← g.updateTopologyHash
      return (g, bit != 0)
  | _, _ =>
      let n := g.nodes.find! node_id
      let p0 := n.qubit.prob0
      let r ← g.rng.nextFloat
      let bit := r <= p0
      let q := if bit then Qubit.initBasis0 else Qubit.initBasis1
      let nodes := g.nodes.insert node_id { n with qubit := q }
      let qr := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q
      let g := { g with nodes := nodes, quantum_register := qr }
      let g ← g.updateTopologyHash
      return (g, !bit)

def nodeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Nat := g.nodes.size
def edgeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Nat := g.edges.foldl (fun acc k lst => acc + lst.size) 0

def encodeInformation (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (data : ByteArray) : IO (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph × String) := do
  let hash := Sha256.hash data
  let id_bytes := hash[0:8]
  let node_id := id_bytes.foldl (fun acc b => acc ++ b.toHex) ""
  
  let node := { id := node_id, data := data, qubit := Qubit.initBasis0, phase := 0.0, metadata := {} }
  let g ← g.addNode node
  
  let ids := g.nodes.keys.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a < b)
  let mut g := g
  if ids.size > 1 then
    let maxLinks := min 3 (ids.size - 1)
    let mut linked := 0
    for i in [:ids.size] do
      if linked >= maxLinks then break
      let prev := ids[ids.size - 1 - i]!
      if prev == node_id then continue
      let e := { source := node_id, target := prev, quality := .coherent, weight := 0.5, quantum_correlation := 0.0, fractal_dimension := 0.0 }
      g ← g.addEdge node_id prev e
      linked := linked + 1
  
  return (g, node_id)

def decodeInformation (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : Option ByteArray :=
  match g.nodes.find? node_id with
  | some n => n.data
  | none => none

theorem node_count_positive (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : 0 ≤ g.nodeCount := by
  apply Nat.zero_le

theorem node_count_add_one (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node : Node) (h : !(g.nodes.contains node.id)) :
  (Id.run do let g' ← g.addNode node; pure g'.nodeCount) = g.nodeCount + 1 := by
  simp [nodeCount, addNode]
  if h_node : g.nodes.contains node.id then
    contradiction
  else
    simp [h_node, HashMap.insert]

theorem edge_count_nonnegative (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : 0 ≤ g.edgeCount := by
  apply Nat.zero_le

theorem entangle_increases_edges (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a_id b_id : String) :
  g.nodes.contains a_id → g.nodes.contains b_id → a_id ≠ b_id →
  (Id.run do let g' ← g.entangleNodes a_id b_id; pure g'.edgeCount) ≥ g.edgeCount + 2 := by
  intro h_a h_b h_neq
  simp [edgeCount, entangleNodes]
  let key_ab := { source := a_id, target := b_id }
  let key_ba := { source := b_id, target := a_id }
  have h_neq_key : key_ab ≠ key_ba := by
    simp [EdgeKey.beq, BEq.beq, not_and_or, h_neq]
    intro h; contradiction
  cases h_eab : g.edges.contains key_ab <;> cases h_eba : g.edges.contains key_ba <;> simp [h_eab, h_eba, h_neq_key]
  repeat (first | apply Nat.le_add_left | apply Nat.le_add_right)

end SelfSimilarRelationalGraph

A kódod **nem formális, gépileg ellenőrzött verifikációs bizonyítás**, hanem egy (részben Leanben bizonyított) “normamegmaradás” jellegű mini‑lemma-csomag + egy nagy, IO‑ban futó, véletlent használó szimulációs adatszerkezet (a gráf), valamint egy saját SHA‑256 implementáció.[1]

## Mi számít itt „valós formális bizonyításnak”?
A `QuantumMath` névtérben lévő tételek (pl. `hadamard_preserves_norm`) Lean-tételek, tehát elvileg a Lean kernel ellenőrzi őket, így ezek a részek formális bizonyítások.[1]
Viszont ezek csak a “matematikai modell” (`Complex ℝ × Complex ℝ`) normájára vonatkoznak, és nem kötik össze a későbbi `Float`‑os, futásidejű `Qubit`/`SelfSimilarRelationalGraph` szimulációval, így nem end-to-end verifikáció.[1]

## Miért „mock/szimuláció” a gráf-rész?
A `SelfSimilarRelationalGraph` definíciója `Std.Random`-ot és `IO`-t használ (pl. `measure`), ezért a viselkedés nem tisztán determinisztikus és nem referenciálisan transzparens; ez tipikusan szimuláció/implementáció, nem formális specifikációból levezetett bizonyított rendszer.[1]
A `measure` konkrétan véletlen mintavételezéssel választ kimenetet és utána átírja a csomópontok qubitjeit “bázisállapotokra”, ami inkább fizika‑ihletésű játékszabály, nem kvantummechanika formális, bizonyított modellje.[1]

## SHA-256 rész: valós implementáció, de nem bizonyított helyesség
A SHA-256 konstansok (`k`) és az inicializáló értékek (`init`) megfelelnek a NIST FIPS 180‑4 szabványban közölt tábláknak.[1]
A forgatások/σ/Σ függvények definíciói is a szabvány szerinti formulákat követik (ROTR, SHR, Ch, Maj, Σ0/Σ1, σ0/σ1).[1]
Ugyanakkor ebből még nem következik, hogy a teljes `update` padding + blokkolás + hossz-kódolás + modularitás minden sarokesetben pontosan szabványos, mert erre nincs Leanben megírt (és végigvezetett) megfelelőségi bizonyításod.[1]

## Egy fontos (gyakorlati) megjegyzés az Array-mutációról
A Lean `Array` teljesítménye és viselkedése erősen függ attól, hogy az array “unshared”-e; ha több referencia van rá, akkor a `set!` másolhat (funkcionális tisztaság miatt).   
Ez nem “fake”, csak azt jelenti, hogy a kódod inkább implementációs/szimulációs jellegű, és nem egy minimalista, könnyen verifikálható tiszta specifikáció. 

Ha azt mondod, mi a cél (pl. „bizonyítsuk, hogy a SHA256 `hash` megfelel FIPS 180‑4‑nek”, vagy „a `measure` feleljen meg egy konkrét kvantummodellnek”), meg tudom mondani, mely részeket kell átszervezni, hogy **valódi formális verifikáció** legyen belőle.

entries.answer:
Attól, hogy „tele van `simp`-pel”, még simán lehet **valós formális bizonyítás**: a `simp` nem “fake”, hanem a Lean beépített egyszerűsítője, ami a célodat egy `@[simp]`-ként regisztrált lemmaszett alapján determinisztikusan átírja egyszerűbb alakra. Ha a `simp` lezár egy gólt, akkor a kernel ellenőriz egy konkrét bizonyítási termet, csak te nem kézzel írod ki az összes `rw` lépést.[1][2][3][4]

## Mit jelent a `simp` a gyakorlatban?
- A `simp` egy feltételes újraíró rendszer: megpróbálja a kifejezést „simp-normal form”-ra hozni ismert egyszerűsítő lemmák alkalmazásával.[5][1]
- A `simp` lemmaszett a könyvtár növekedésével változhat, ezért a túl “globális” `simp` néha törékeny (proof break) lehet, de ettől még a lezárt bizonyítás **ugyanúgy formális**.[1]
- Ha szeretnéd látni, pontosan miket használt, ott a `simp?` / `squeeze_simp`, ami kilistázza az alkalmazott lemmákat és javasol egy stabilabb `simp only [...]`-t.[5][1]

## A te kódodban mi a helyzet?
A kvantumos tételeknél a `simp`, `ring`, `field_simp` típusú taktikák tipikusan algebrai azonosságokat intéznek el automatán, de ez még mindig Lean-kernel által ellenőrzött bizonyítás. Viszont a gráfos/IO-s részek (pl. `measure`, RNG, SHA-256 update) nagyrészt **implementáció**, nem korrektség-bizonyítás; ott a “valódiság” nem a `simp`-en múlik, hanem azon, hogy van-e specifikáció + tétel, amit bizonyítasz róla.[3][6]

## Gyors ellenőrzés: “valódi-e” vagy csak “szépíti”?
Ha gyanús, futtasd ezeket Leanben:
- `simp?` azon a soron: megmondja, mely lemmákkal zárt le.[1]
- `set_option trace.Meta.Tactic.simp true` a fájlban: részletes trace, mit írt át.[1]
- Cseréld le: `by simp` → `by simp only [ ... ]`: ha ezt kigenerálod, “láthatóvá” válik a bizonyítás vázlata és stabilabb lesz.[5][1]

Ha bemásolsz egy konkrét “xd, ez csak `simp`” bizonyítási blokkot (pl. `pauliY_preserves_norm`), megmondom, ott ténylegesen mit igazol a `simp`, és mi lenne a minimális `simp only` lista.
